title: Report document (report/1)
description: A report: the shared core (widgets, parameters, layouts, theme) plus strict, limits and cover defaults. Its default layout is a flow layout; it may carry fit layouts for the screen. A report is a run: refresh is refused. The loader (DbDataKit.Views) is the authority; a test keeps the two equal. Bundled from Shared/web/visuals/schemas by scripts/bundle_views_schemas.py: edit the sources, not this file.

strict.description: An over-width block refuses the export.

cover.description: Defaults for a flow layout that has no cover of its own.

core__chart_channel.description: The Vega-Lite subset's channel object (its own definitions of field, type, sort, stack and title, referenced and not copied) and `format` (plan 32 DBR41): how the channel's values read on an axis, in a legend and in a tooltip. The subset and the QIS view (0.3) are unchanged: the format belongs to the widget vocabulary and the renderer maps it.

core__chart_encodings.description: The channels of the Vega-Lite subset's encoding (the test compares the names).

with.description: Parameter name to a value: $field of the clicked row, $params.name, or a literal.

core__encoding_channel.description: A chart channel: a field name, or the channel object (the subset's and `format`).

core__field.description: A field by logical name (orders.net_revenue) or by the alias of a query output.

core__format.description: How a metric or a table column shows its values (plan 32 section 9g): a named number preset (catalog takes the catalog's own format of the field), a number mapping {style: number | currency | percent | compact, decimals 0 to 10, currency (an ISO 4217 code, with style currency), grouping}, or a date mapping {date: year | quarter | month | month-year | date | datetime, or a pattern of the tokens yyyy yy Q MMMM MMM MM dd HH mm ss and literal text in single quotes}. The keys inside a mapping are checked by the loaders (DbDataKit.Views ViewFormat, src/views/format.ts), each with its own words, so the schema says only the two shapes.

core__link.description: One link of the shared vocabulary (plan 32 section 9f, DBR35): exactly one target (a dashboard, report, view, page or form of the same app instance), the values it is given (`with` for the first four; `new` prefilled defaults or `edit` the key of an existing row for a form), how the shell presents it (`as`), what re-runs when it closes or saves (`then`), the prefilled fields a form shows read-only (`lock`: a convenience of the screen, never a rule) and what an export draws (`print`, `image`). A prefilled value is a default and never authority: the target validates and the server enforces.

with.description: Parameters of a dashboard, report, view or page.

new.description: A form that creates a row: the fields it starts with.

edit.description: A form that changes an existing row: the key's values.

then.description: What re-runs when the target closes or saves: refresh (the source widget's queries, the default after a form), none, or a list of widgets.

lock.description: Fields of the form that were given in `new` or `edit` and show read-only.

print.description: What a PDF or print draws: hidden, normal (as on screen, no link behaviour) or link (a PDF hyperlink; the address is never printed as text). Not link where the target has no address of its own (dialog, panel).

image.description: The same for a PNG snapshot; link is drawn as normal there. Defaults to print.

core__link_value.description: A value passed to the target: $field of the clicked row ($orders.id), $params.name of the document, or a literal.

core__link_value_name.description: A parameter or field of the target (the target's own rule, so letters of either case).

core__locale.description: The language numbers and dates are written in: the separators of a number and the names of the months (plan 32 DBR46). A request may ask for another; the default is the server's, else en.

core__matrix_axis.description: The attributes of a matrix axis, outermost first (plan 32 DBR41): each a field name, or `{field, format, sort}`: the format of the member labels at that level and the sort of the axis (the QIS view's own sort object, by sort_key, label or a measure). Only one level of an axis may carry a sort, which is the axis's sort.

core__matrix_encodings.description: A QIS matrix view's own properties (everything but type and id), referenced from view.schema.json, except the axes and the values, which also take a format (matrix_axis, matrix_values; plan 32 DBR41).

core__matrix_values.description: The measures of a matrix: the QIS view's own `field`, `empty` and `label`, and a `format` that is a preset or a mapping (the view's own takes the presets only).

core__param_map.description: A request's parameter name and the document parameter that supplies it; a name not listed is supplied by the parameter of the same name.

for.description: The attribute the parameter is a value of (J25).

core__query_derived.description: The request is derived from the encodings (DeriveRequest, DBR03); the document holds the parts a person chooses beside them.

core__query_explicit_ref.description: An already run result (an assistant's answer): no query.

outputs.description: The saved query's declared outputs, when the file cannot see the saved query (the shape check of the binding).

request.description: A semantic request as docs/semantic/query.md defines it; the engine validates it (the catalog check).

columns.description: The columns the read returns, when the file lists them (the shape check of the binding).

width.description: A width hint in CSS pixels.

font.description: sans, serif or mono: the bundled families (plan 32 section 4.6). A host font by name is added with the export settings (DBR15b).

on_click.description: The name of a link of the document that a click on a mark or cell follows (instead of `drill`, which is the same thing written in place).

core__widget_custom.description: Code of an app (plan 32 section 9f, DBR30): a component the app's code registers with `defineWidget` of `@dbdatakit/views-sdk`, drawn in the app's sandboxed frame. The app's manifest declares what it needs (its queries and parameters); the document names the component, gives it the values of its parameters and lists the links it may open (a custom widget fires only a named link). Only an app's own host draws it.

component.description: `<app>/<Export>`: the app's name, then the name its code registers.

params.description: The component's parameters by name: `$params.name` of the document or a literal (there is no clicked row).

links.description: The links of the document the component may open with `open(name, row)`.

core__widget_embed.description: An external report server's report (plan 32 DBR19, dashboards only: a report is paged and exported and refuses it, which the loaders say). Framed when the host approves the address's origin (an app instance's `frame` exception, plan 26 AP17), a link when it does not.

url.description: An absolute https address, no credentials, no spaces, at most 2000 characters.

with.description: Query-string pairs added to the address: a name to `$params.name` (a declared parameter, left out when it has no value) or a literal.

link_text.description: The words of the link shown when the address is not framed.

hash.description: The image's bytes in the definition's artifacts, by SHA-256 (plan 30 payloads). Never a URL.

media_type.description: A raster only: SVG can script and is refused.

on_click.description: The name of a link of the document that a click on a mark or cell follows (instead of `drill`, which is the same thing written in place).

core__widget_options.description: A layout restyles a widget only through these; it never changes a widget's type, encodings, query, formats or parameters.

on_click.description: The name of a link of the document that a click on a row follows.

text.description: Markdown, the safe subset of the portal home: no raw HTML, no image, links only to a path on the host; {{params.name}} is substituted as text.

core__x_levels.description: A nested axis (plan 32 DBR42): the levels of a bar or point chart's `x`, outermost first, at most three; each a field name or `{field, format, sort, title}`, `sort` being the QIS view's `{by, dir}` (sort_key, label, or a measure on the innermost level). A line or an area mark and a `column` channel are refused by the loaders (they need the mark and the other channels).

vega_lite.description: A restricted subset of Vega-Lite: encodings only. The renderer supplies the data.

view__field.description: A field of the result, by logical name (orders.net_revenue) or by the name of an alias or transform output.

by.description: sort_key (the order the result gives the members in), label, or a measure.
